toursSection.title: Tours &
toursSection.subtitle: Experiences
toursSection.description1: At Amexing Experience, every journey is designed in a personalized way, combining hospitality, local knowledge, and access to carefully curated experiences. We connect our travelers with the essence of San Miguel de Allende through private encounters with artists, artisans, chefs, studios, workshops, vineyards, and local hosts.
toursSection.description2: Each itinerary adapts to your interests, pace, and travel style, creating an authentic, elegant experience deeply connected to the destination. More than visiting San Miguel, we invite you to discover it from within.

requestAccess.title: Access Request for Partners
requestAccess.subtitle: Premium platform for destination services
requestAccess.aboutP1: Amexing CRM is designed for partners who coordinate private services, reservations, and personalized experiences for clients, guests, groups, or properties in San Miguel de Allende and the Bajío region.
requestAccess.aboutP2: The platform allows partners to centralize requests, reservations, and operational follow-up for private transportation, tours, curated experiences, and special services, with the support of a local team specialized in hospitality, logistics, and personalized service.
requestAccess.aboutP3: Access is subject to individual review and approval in order to preserve the quality, safety, and service standards that define our operation.
